featuresSection.heading: Built for visual control and real ownership.
featuresSection.subheading: Every layout, breakpoint, content schema, and workspace connection works together in one cohesive editor.
featuresSection.f1Desc: Insert, drag, reparent, and nest containers directly on the canvas or in Layers & Structure. Edit CSS layout, spacing, typography, Global/Local headers and footers, and scoped custom HTML/CSS/JS widgets.
featuresSection.f2Desc: Preview and override Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile styles independently—grid columns, padding, visibility, and typography—without altering the other sizes.
featuresSection.f3Desc: Organize nested pages, SEO slugs, and custom Content Types with taxonomies and dynamic repeaters bound directly to your data.
featuresSection.f4Desc: Your editable page documents and original assets reside in your Google Drive, while structured portfolio records and CMS collections live in your Google Sheets—linked explicitly with a dedicated Workspace authorization step.
featuresSection.f4Point1: Google Drive stores page JSON & original media
featuresSection.f4Point2: Google Sheets stores structured records & CMS tabs

howItWorks.heading: From sign-in to published website in four clear steps.
howItWorks.subheading: Signing in establishes your Builly identity first; connecting Google Drive and Sheets happens as a separate, transparent authorization step.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Authenticate your Builly owner identity via Supabase Auth. Only basic identity profile info is requested at sign-in.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Grant separate Google Workspace authorization when you are ready to link your personal portfolio folder and spreadsheet.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Compose sections freely, adjust Desktop/Tablet/Mobile breakpoints, bind CMS collections, and preview changes immediately.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Compile multi-page static releases for fast Cloudflare delivery while your editable page files stay in your own Drive.

ownership.heading: Identity stays in Supabase Auth. Your website stays in your Google Workspace.
ownership.subheading: Builly separates authentication from content ownership so your site data is never trapped in a proprietary database.
ownership.c1Desc: Handles Google sign-in and assigns your canonical Builly owner ID. Supabase does not store your pages, CMS schemas, media assets, or portfolio records.
ownership.c2Desc: Authorized separately after login—even with a different Google account if you prefer—so your Drive folders and spreadsheets remain directly under your control.
ownership.c3Desc: Verifies your Builly owner session on API calls, keeps Google Workspace refresh credentials encrypted server-side, and serves compiled static releases quickly.
